julesThoughtProcess: I selected Cyber Teal (#00FFCC) to evoke a sense of calm, atmospheric energy that matches the grounded, hopeful vibe of the story.
storyPanel: In the bustling lower levels of Neo-Kyoto, a mechanic finishes patching up a weary delivery drone. It's tough work, but the hot synth-ramen from the stall next door and the gentle hum of neon signs make the long nights worth it. A quiet moment of connection in a chaotic, neon-lit world.
